verdict.summary: The change correctly moves nonce validation into a non-empty ChallengeNonce type, adds an explicit OS-CSPRNG constructor with fail-closed entropy handling, preserves wire values verbatim for externally supplied nonces, and propagates the typed nonce through request construction, response generation, and equality-based replay checking. The expression feature alone enables the new optional dependency, preserving the lean default build. The focused tests exercise rejection, verbatim adoption, generated format/non-repetition, contract propagation, and mismatch rejection; the documentation is appropriately explicit that from_wire does not establish freshness and that this is hardening rather than a cryptographic soundness claim. No injected reviewer instructions were found in the diff.
